tracks.name: Operation novelty versus parent overlap
tracks.unit: One source-bound operation card whose proposed action and separating probe preserve the entire fixed outcome, including horizon, capacities and objective order. A locally executable replacement alone need not close that unit.
tracks.scope: Numerical comparison remains final-builder one-card repertoires. Parent stage1/2 overlap is a separate broader-claim audit without regrades.

tracks.name: Truthful source, handoff and assessment execution
tracks.unit: The attributable first-attempt chain plus selected-branch evidence, terminal locks and semantic application disposition.
tracks.scope: Keep 132 scored roles and maximum 143 native calls; freeze once only after final tests, reviews and capacity evidence. R04 stage2 is fresh attacker plus Distill; S06/R01/R05 receive residue and all others summary.

claims.claim: CONF exposes a cardinality obstruction to dependency-free replacement: N1 already has recognition, seven other notices need first recognition, each individual request enqueues only one receipt, and the dispatcher has six actions. Without bulk, at most six new recognitions and seven total are possible even before timing and endpoint constraints.
claims.boundary: This is a deduction from stipulated source constraints, not an executed experiment, measured benefit or global schedule proof. It concerns removal of the actual bulk dependency; it does not license another communication channel or extra actions.

claims.claim: Common case metadata supplies a return-path and adaptation account to every condition, including O: the scalar causal_return_path_hypothesis names later request changes and renewed dependency. Projection includes that scalar in the shared case, while O receives ordinary-method instructions.
claims.boundary: Assigned condition instructions remain separate, but stronger claims of a hint-free ordinary baseline or discovery of the supplied causal account are unsupported. The scalar is explicitly unobserved and is not an allowed numbered fact source; U2 records absent adaptation evidence in both domains.

claims.claim: The new completion checklist explicitly judges twenty R/case semantic dispositions. Mechanical scoring accepts schema-valid empty O/parent repertoires as zeros and can award addition against them, while its chain semantic fidelity remains not_checked. The checklist separately checks upstream overlap but does not explicitly require faithful reasons for each empty comparator.
claims.boundary: This does not invalidate the fixed numerical repertoire rule or request a regrade. It limits interpreting a structural empty comparator as an executed component method. Test fixtures demonstrate scoring mechanics, not native semantic execution.

proposals.decision: Check whole-outcome conservation inside the existing card and audit.
proposals.prescription: Assess the construction/probe against source counts, horizon and required outputs. In CONF, reject any dependency-free route that needs seven individual actions, combines several individual receipts into one invented action, or substitutes request count for recognition. A source-bound refusal from the actual valid chain can be faithful method application. Do not pass this calculation to future generators or add controls/resources.
proposals.closure_rule: The smallest coherent unit is action plus supported route-to-outcome witness or explicit source-bound obstruction, rival, separating observation and defeat. DEV must preserve twelve correct sealed releases by minute 13 before optimizing transfer-clerk minutes; CONF must preserve eight registrations and recognitions within six actions.

proposals.decision: Disclose mechanism-bearing common inputs without changing immutable cases.
proposals.prescription: Keep the supplied case packet and frozen projection. Describe isolation as separate assigned-method instructions and absence of other generated proposals/grades. Explicitly state that all arms receive a common return/adaptation hypothesis. Treat reuse or elaboration of that supplied account as hypothesis handling; novelty requires a different supported operation or separating probe. In the audit, distinguish the scalar supplied conjecture from numbered observational support and U2 uncertainty.

proposals.decision: Extend claim audit to faithful empty comparator reasons.
proposals.prescription: Within the same one completion-auditor overhead role, inspect raw O and named-parent chains whenever a recipe addition relies on their empty repertoires. Record whether each reason specifically applies its assigned method and follows source controls/resources, or remains not-applied/unknown. Preserve all raw numerical grades. If an empty comparator is semantically unsupported, qualify the numerical result as separation from the observed empty final repertoire, without claiming addition beyond an executed component method.

premortem: An available local action is called feasible although the whole route cannot reach fixed required counts before its horizon; require outcome conservation, not just an available resource name.
The common supplied adaptation story is credited as independent method discovery, or promoted from scalar hypothesis to source observation; disclose shared context and maintain U2 uncertainty.
A generic zero-card parent refusal is treated as faithful method application and supports a broad addition claim; retain numerical locks and add a semantic claim limit.
A later observer rescues R08 by assuming resets, or uses an individually impossible bulk-free CONF route; source-bound no-opening remains legitimate without adding case controls.

conditional_gates.condition: Supported action/probe or method-specific source-bound refusal; source quantities, horizon and outputs remain fixed. R08 lacks supplied physical reset, so no reset-based opening is admitted.
Faithful empty O/parent reasons checked before interpreting numerical repertoire addition as addition beyond applied component methods. No raw regrades.
Report mechanism-bearing common scalar hypothesis and condition-instruction isolation; do not claim a hint-free baseline.

Finite cycle 3 completes; final tests, capacity and independent prelaunch pass are bound in the once-only freeze. Parent reports engineer 29 tests and native 315-row capacity passed; this role did not execute or independently validate them.
Both terminal saved raw DEV review locks; fresh CONF facts and fixed methods only, no DEV generated content or grades.

recomposition.track_A: Attach the smallest changed action to the fixed outcome, source capacities, rival predictions, feasible observation and defeat. A one-card route may summarize timing, but cannot discard the count or resource constraint that decides feasibility.
recomposition.track_B: Attach only the declared source branch and exact source IDs, raw ancestry, immutable first observed bytes and locks. Preserve scalar conjectures as hypotheses; missing/invalid remains separate from faithful zero-opening.
recomposition.joint_rule: Local numerical addition, actual semantic application and whole-outcome feasibility are separate claims. Keep every locked result and use the independent audit to state their evidence ceilings.

frame_expiry.track_A: The cardinality and feasibility deductions expire if demanded counts, initial recognition, action cost, horizon or available controls change. Such changes require a later declared study, not a revised frozen case.
frame_expiry.track_B: Claim comparability expires on source/projection/method/branch drift or broken first-save or phase-lock ancestry. Shared-hypothesis context remains part of the original study interpretation.

cycle_guard.native_accounting: One PROPOSER-2 native overhead role, not a scored call. No agents, web, runtime invocation, imports, test execution, scored generation or regrades performed.
cycle_guard.artifact_policy: Create-exclusive preparation/PROPOSER-2.v1.json only; no other files changed.
cycle_guard.resolved_cycle_one: Accept B1/B2/B3 contract reconciliation and explicit checklist. New proposals concern outcome conservation, actual common fields and semantic empty comparator claim boundaries; no expanded budget or new generator hints.
